#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

bool check(int w, int m) {
    while (m > 0) {
        int r = m % w;
        if (r >= 0 && r <= 1) {
            m /= w;
        } else if (r == w - 1) {
            m++;
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line);
    std::istringstream iss(line);
    int w, m;
    iss >> w >> m;
    std::cout << (check(w, m) ? "YES" : "NO") << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
